scenario: LCON.2.6.1 integer determinism — arithmetic right shift saturates at -1. `-1 >> 8` stays -1 (sign bit propagates through every shifted position per LEXP.7.14.1). Guard `(t.x >> 8) == -1` gates the emit; fact_count 2 confirms.
rules_ds:
schema T scope logical:
    x: Int key

schema Hit scope logical:
    d: Int key

rule r:
    T t where (t.x >> 8) == -1
->
    emit Hit logical d: 0
